data.description:
About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.

Über die Rolle
Du übernimmst die Führung der Bereiche Druck und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Produkte effizient und termingerecht entstehen. Die Rolle verbindet operative Führung, klare Prioritätensetzung und kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung. Dein Beitrag stellt sicher, dass unsere Premiumprodukte rechtzeitig, wirtschaftlich und in der gewohnten Qualität bei unseren Kunden ankommen.

Wie du Neugier täglich lebst
  • Organisation und fachliche Führung deines Teams im Bereich Druck und Rahmenfertigung
  • Überwachung des täglichen Produktionsablaufs inkl. Qualitäts- und Prozesskontrolle
  • Anwendung von Lean-Methoden (z. B. 5S, KVP) zur Steigerung von Produktivität und Prozesssicherheit
  • Effiziente Planung und Steuerung von Personal, Maschinen und Material
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller Sicherheits-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsstandards

    • Wie du Eindruck hinterlässt
  • Verantwortung für die Herstellung hochwertiger Druck- und Rahmenprodukte
  • Motivation und Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden
  • Sichtbare, hands-on Führung mit Fokus auf Ergebnisse, Qualität und Zusammenarbeit
  • Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer hohen Produktions- und Qualitätsstandards

    • Was du mitbringst
  • Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung
  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams in einem Produktions- oder Industrieumfeld
  • Sicheres Verständnis von Produktionsabläufen, Planung und Qualitätssicherung
  • Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten und klare, verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und solide Englischkenntnisse für den Arbeitsalltag

    • Was dich besonders macht
  • Berufserfahrung oder Qualifikation im Druckbereich
  • Weiterbildung zum Meister, Techniker oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
    • Über uns
    Bei der Storio Group helfen wir Menschen, die Momente ihres Lebens festzuhalten. Wir stellen personalisierte Fotoprodukte her, die flüchtige Erinnerungen in Dinge verwandeln, die man behalten, teilen und wiedererleben kann.

    Jeder bei der Storio Group hilft, unsere Produkte zu entwickeln und unser Unternehmen zu formen. Sie werden die Auswirkungen Ihrer Arbeit täglich sehen. Wir laden Sie ein, Ihre Spuren in unserem Geschäft, unseren Produkten und im Leben unserer Kunden zu hinterlassen.

    Wir handeln mit Herz, indem wir Menschen an erste Stelle setzen und verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzen. Wir geben unser Bestes und streben in allem, was wir tun, nach hohen Standards. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Arbeit und ergreifen Initiative, um Lösungen zu finden. Wir sind neugierig, lernen immer dazu und probieren Neues aus. Wir finden Freude an unserer Arbeit und schaffen ein positives Umfeld.

    Chancengleichheit & Recht auf Arbeit

    Storio Group ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet, Vielfalt feiert und ein integratives Umfeld fördert. Sollten Sie angemessene Vorkehrungen für Vorstellungsgespräche benötigen, kontaktieren Sie bitte unser HR-Team.

    Bewerber müssen zudem das gesetzliche Recht haben, im Land der Position zu arbeiten, ohne ein Sponsoring zu benötigen

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. 
 
As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

What you will do daily
  • Help prospective customers understand how our AC/DC approach fits within their software development life cycle
  • Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations 
  • Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams
  • Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions
  • Provide technical enablement to channel partners to raise their level of service

    • Experience and qualifications
  • Some practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering highly desirable
  • Familiarity of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
  • Passion for technology and successful customer outcomes
  • Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form
  • Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge
  • A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills
  • German language is desirable but not a hard requirement.
    •  

    In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

data.description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

    • IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

    • IT Security & Compliance 

    You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

    You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

    • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


    • What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  


    • For the Senior IT Administrator level

    Candidates considered for the Senior IT Administrator level should additionally bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant hands-on IT administration or systems engineering experience, ideally in a technical or engineering-driven environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across Linux and macOS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex endpoint and system issues.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of MDM, IAM, SSO/MFA, endpoint security, networking, and access management.
  • Strong networking knowledge with practical experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
  • Experience independently owning technical projects from solution design and implementation through documentation and ongoing operation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, networks, cloud services, identity, and infrastructure, with the ability to resolve complex issues without relying primarily on external providers.
  • Experience using scripting and automation to improve IT operations and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Ability to proactively identify weaknesses in an existing IT environment and independently propose and implement secure, scalable improvements.
  • Experience acting as a technical escalation point and supporting or mentoring less experienced colleagues.
  • Ability to work confidently with Engineering and DevOps teams and communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • A strong security mindset and interest in taking increasing ownership of Information Security, ISO 27001, TISAX, and ISMS-related topics.

    • Previous hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, TISAX, an ISMS, or security audits is an advantage for the Senior level, but not required.

    Most importantly, you: 

  • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

  • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

  • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

  • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

  • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

  • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  

    •  


    Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


    • Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

    • About Apex.AI

    Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.

With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

With over 10 million end users and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month — and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.

As a Senior Software Engineer - Data & AI Platform (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:

Your Responsibilities:

  • Build Analytical Query Engines: Connect our transactional backends (MongoDB) with modern analytical event stores (ClickHouse) to support sub-second aggregations across millions of ticket transactions.

  • Implement AI Retrieval & Reporting Workflows: Build and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic parsers, and agentic query supervisors that convert natural language prompts into deterministic, accurate SQL and aggregation queries.

  • Maintain Low-Latency Reporting APIs: Write high-performance production services in Go or TypeScript/Node.js that power real-time reporting dashboards for global organizers without degrading transactional processing.

  • Centralize Data Flows & Auditing: Partner with platform and security teams to build clean data schemas, strict audit trails, and automated evaluation suites that catch hallucinated data or metric drifts before they reach clients.

  • Sprint Scoping & Architecture: Collaborate directly in monthly in-person architecture sessions in Frankfurt alongside the VP of Engineering, CTO, and engineering leads to define technical milestones.


    • What you will need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building high-throughput, distributed production services using Go, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js.

  • Analytical Warehousing Experience: Direct, hands-on production experience with ClickHouse (or closely related low-latency analytical engines like DuckDB, Snowflake, or Apache Pinot) for high-volume event streams.

  • Database Mastery: Solid practical experience with both document/NoSQL stores (MongoDB) and relational engines (PostgreSQL).

  • Production AI / RAG Engineering: Proven experience deploying production RAG systems, function calling, evaluation frameworks, and supervisor architectures (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration layers).

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Strong understanding of distributed message streaming using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or cloud pub/sub mechanisms.

  • Pragmatic Mindset: High autonomy and scrappiness—you choose reliable, deterministic validation layers and battle-tested databases over fragile AI hype.

    • Why join vivenu?

    Live Entertainment Tech
    Play a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.

    Sustainable Growth
    We scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.

    Top-tier Team
    Collaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.

    Global DNA
    We’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.

    Fast Growing, in All Aspects
    Sifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.

    Next-Gen Leaders & Insights
    Work alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.

    vivenu Inclusion Statement
    At vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.

Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Operations & Strategy Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our mission for you

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers.

 

About trawa

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

The Team

You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates.

 

Who we are looking for

  • Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

  • Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus.

  • Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work.

  • Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus.

  • High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus.

  • Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

What you'll do

As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive:

  • Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. You make this process faster, more robust and scalable.

  • Stabilise and grow our margins: Our customers hedge their energy costs with long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Futures/Forwards. You are responsible for stabilising our margins on these hedges and increasing them in the medium term – covering a multi-million euro gross margin.

  • Pave the way to more complex products: Over the past three years, we have shown that we can profitably price, buy and sell energy. You build on that foundation and develop our long-term offering towards more complex, higher-margin products that fit our customers' needs even better.

  • Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets – so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

 

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • Business understanding: You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

  • Portfolio knowledge: You understand our long-term product portfolio (PPAs, Futures/Forwards), our customers' hedging needs and how pricing, margins and risk come together in our offers.

  • CPQ mapping: You have mapped our current CPQ process – from customer request and pricing to offer creation and trade execution – and identified the key pain points and margin levers.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Go-to CPQ owner: You are the go-to person for our CPQ process and have implemented first improvements that make it faster and more robust.

  • Margin transparency: You have created transparency on our margins across long-term hedges and derived first measures to stabilise them.

  • Target process: You have designed a target CPQ process, started its implementation and proposed first, more complex products for our long-term offering.

 

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements.

  3. Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems.

  5. VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems.

  6. Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

data.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d): the first point of contact and the engine room of our Corporate Affairs unit. You will report directly to our Chief Corporate Affairs Officer (CCAO) and run the day-to-day work that keeps a growing, cross-border agenda coherent and moving. This frees the CCAO to focus on relationships and strategy.

You will own ambiguous, cross-functional execution independently. Strategic positioning and external representation remain with the CCAO.

What You'll Do

  • Own the CCAO's agenda and priorities, acting as her first point of contact internally and externally.

  • Drive project management for Corporate Affairs initiatives across Brussels, Berlin, Hesse, and international markets, including tracking dependencies and milestones across locations.

  • Run planning, OKR, and reporting processes for the unit on a reliable cadence.

  • Build decision-ready briefings, talking points, and papers for senior management and the Board, prepared ahead of need.

  • Prepare and follow up on meetings with government bodies, EU institutions, parliament, and industry associations.

  • Partner with the CEO Office, Finance, Investor Relations, Legal, and technical teams on cross-functional initiatives.

  • Manage relationships with external partners such as agencies and advisors.

  • Enable rapid, coordinated responses to short-notice political and stakeholder developments.

What You Bring

  • Proven senior-level experience in chief of staff, executive support, corporate affairs, public affairs, or government relations roles.

  • Solid understanding of political processes at federal, state, and EU level, and of public affairs fundamentals. Interest in energy and technology policy is a plus.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to keep many cross-market threads moving without dropping details.

  • Experience with OKR-based planning, stakeholder mapping, and cross-functional coordination, plus confidence with planning and project management tools.

  • Clear, precise written communication in English and German, with a focus on decisions. You prepare materials that senior leaders and the Board can act on without rework.

  • Ownership and initiative: you anticipate needs, flag issues before they are asked about, and take full accountability for the unit's execution.

  • Sound judgment on operational decisions such as scheduling, sequencing, and partner management, with the ability to work without close supervision.

  • Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive political, regulatory, and Board-level information.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to Brussels and Berlin.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a scale-up or early-growth company.

  • Experience in energy, fusion, or other deep-tech sectors.

  • Experience with EU-level, parliamentary, or industry association engagement.

  • Experience supporting a C-level executive in a cross-border organization.

What We Offer

Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs, whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing. You choose what fits your lifestyle.

Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

data.description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

data.description:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

data.description:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

  • Outstanding communication skills, a passion for explaining language conventions, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs, ideally in an editorial process, and awareness of their limitations (hallucinations, biases, outdated sources) and of legal and ethical considerations around data use and copyright

  • Structured work approach to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing weekly priorities, plan around dependencies, and keep teams informed

data.description:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions.

You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value.

Your Mission

  • Own the full recruiting cycle: from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor: clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward.

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates, particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles.

  • Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution.

  • Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value.

  • Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous.

  • You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles.

  • Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent, based on evidence rather than titles or impressions.

  • Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation.

Your Experience

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus.

  • Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches, with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates.

  • Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly.

  • Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements.

  • Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes.

  • Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters.

  • Fluent English and German (at least C2 level)

Your Profile

  • You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster.

As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core.

You work alongside our product and engineering team, with a mentor who reviews your work and helps you grow. This is not a shadowing internship: you take on real problems, ship real tools, and see them used every day.

What you will do

Learn the business

Build , Measure & Share
